camel_example: aliyun hbr UpdateHanaBackupSetting --region cn-hangzhou --LogBackupUsingBackint true --ClusterId 'cl-000ezvg0000008znz' --DatabaseName SYSTEMDB --CatalogBackupUsingBackint true --EnableAutoLogBackup true
description_en: Updates the backup parameters of an SAP HANA database
description_zh: 更新SAP HANA数据库备份参数
kebab_example: aliyun hbr update-hana-backup-setting --cluster-id cl-000ezvg0000008znz --database-name SYSTEMDB --enable-auto-log-backup true --log-backup-using-backint true --catalog-backup-using-backint true --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateHanaBackupSetting

parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup vault
parameters.name: vault_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic log backup. Valid values:
true: Enables automatic log backup.
false: Disables automatic log backup
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启自动日志备份。
true：开启自动日志备份。
false：不开启自动日志备份
parameters.name: enable_auto_log_backup

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to back up logs to Backint. Valid values:

true: Backs up logs to Backint.
false: Does not back up logs to Backint
parameters.help_zh:
是否日志备份到Backint。

true：将日志备份到Backint。
false：不备份到Backint
parameters.name: log_backup_using_backint

parameters.help_en: The log backup interval in seconds
parameters.help_zh: 日志备份间隔时间，单位秒
parameters.name: log_backup_timeout

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use Backint for catalog backup. Valid values:

true: Uses Backint for catalog backup.
false: Does not use Backint for catalog backup
parameters.help_zh:
Catalog备份是否使用Backint。

true：Catalog备份使用Backint。
false：Catalog备份不使用Backint
parameters.name: catalog_backup_using_backint

Code.description_en: The return code. A value of 200 indicates success

Message.description_en: The returned message. If the request is successful, successful is returned. If an error occurs, the corresponding error message is returned
Message.description_zh: 返回信息描述，成功一般返回successful，错误时会返回相应错误信息

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:
true: The request is successful.
false: The request fails
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。
true：成功
false：失败
